tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — warm linen by day, deep navy at night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the message composer.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and quiet sections: past notes, settings groups.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges (decorative, not a control boundary).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders — at least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every -soft tint (11:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, timestamps; on all surfaces and -soft tints (4.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Olive green: the primary action, selected states, progress. As text on any surface or green-soft (5.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Calm tinted backgrounds: a sent-note confirmation, a gentle tip. Text on it is ink or green.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: wood
tokens.usage: Walnut brown — the bridge itself: secondary emphasis, the recipient's name, illustration. As text on any surface or wood-soft (4.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: wood-soft
tokens.usage: Warm tinted backgrounds: the 'To' strip on a note, onboarding panels.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Deep navy fill: the night band, headers, hero panels. A fill, not a text colour; text on it is on-navy.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a navy fill (10:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Reserved for Jisr's own voice: AI suggestions, rewrite hints. As text on any surface or lavender-soft (4.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: lavender-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an AI suggestion chip or panel. Text on it is ink or lavender.

tokens.name: urgent
tokens.usage: Clay red, safety only: 'reach out now' banners and the crisis button. Always paired with words and an icon, never colour alone. As text on any surface or urgent-soft (4.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: urgent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the safety banner.

tokens.name: on-urgent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an urgent fill.

families.display: "Readex Pro", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Readex Pro", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Readex Pro (Google Fonts): soft, open Arabic and Latin forms. Headlines only.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: خطوة صغيرة نحو من تثق به
styles.usage: One per screen: onboarding and empty states.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans Arabic (Google Fonts). Arabic needs room: body never below 15px, line height 1.6 or more.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: أحتاج أن أتكلم معك عن شيء يضايقني مؤخراً.
styles.usage: Message drafts and all reading text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and privacy notes. Never for anything the person must read to stay safe.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin on mobile; button padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

radius.note: Soft and arched: large radii everywhere, pills for chips — echoing the bridge's arches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the composer.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, the AI suggestion chip.

shadow.note: Barely-there, warm-tinted elevation; flatter at night.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px of solid green (5.2:1 or more on every surface).
